description: A hand-written vtable array with cast mangled names reproduces the bytes of a class that was never written.
Write the class and its virtual methods; the vtable follows.
The mangled identifier and extern "C" spoof the linker name of a static member without declaring it.
Declare the static member in the header and define it with its qualified name.
A rename macro around an include forges a declaration the header does not own.
Header fixes belong in the header, with map evidence.

preferred_shape:
#include <Enemy/Killer.hpp>
/* Use the header's TKiller; widen its layout there when the map proves the unit owns it. */
description: A file-scope class in the .cpp shadows the header's definition and breaks the one-definition rule.
Include the owning header and fix its layout there.
A discarded string literal emits the constructor label without constructing anything.
Recover the factory branch that uses the string.
Unreferenced static data only fills a .rodata gap.
Recover the consumer, or leave the section unmatched.
Returning a reference to a by-value parameter is undefined behavior regardless of the instruction sequence it produces.
Return by value or take the argument by reference.
Indexing through the address of a scalar member walks into neighbouring fields.
Declare the real array field in the owning header.
Widening Mtx to Mtx44 and offsetting into it only moves the stack frame.
Keep the type the API expects; a remaining frame gap is a missing local, not a bigger matrix.

bad_pattern:
f32 (*sqrt)(f32) = JGeometry::TUtil<f32>::sqrt;
f32 dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
preferred_shape:
f32 dist = JGeometry::TUtil<f32>::sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
/* If the target shows a non-inlined call, find the inline that was not expanded rather than forcing an indirect call. */
description: A function pointer bound to a fixed function and called immediately steers the call sequence.
Call the function directly; look for the lost inline if the target differs.

preferred_shape:
f32 fVar1 = (local_24.dot(gpCamera->unk124) + mPlaneD) * -2.0f;
/* If the target really negates a stored negative, name the field so the sign is explained. */
description: `- -x` cancels out and exists only to reproduce an instruction pair.
Reviewer confirms the stored sign against the target and the field name.

preferred_shape:
return (mPosition - other).length();
/* TVec3::length() in include/JSystem/JGeometry/Vec.hpp already has this body. */
description: Six or more statements token-identical to a header inline body are the inline expanded by hand.
Call the inline; expanded bodies are rejected.

preferred_shape:
f32 d = normal.dot(dir);
/* or: keep the wrapper only with `// fabricated` and the objdiff evidence that the target needs the extra frame. */
description: A one-expression static inline with a single call site is usually a stack-shaping helper, not lost source.
Fold it back, or mark it fabricated with evidence.

preferred_shape:
if (mActor != nullptr && mActor->isVisible()) {
/* Keep the null guard unless the target instruction window proves it absent. */
description: Dropping a `&&` term to shave a compare changes behavior.
Keep the term or record the target window that proves it is not there.
Reading a member of a local placeholder class that nothing assigns points at a fabricated layout.
Use the header type whose constructor initializes the field.

preferred_shape:
setPollution(mCount, mMax);
/* Restore the original order unless the target window shows the swapped registers. */
description: Swapping arguments of a non-commutative call to match a register order changes semantics.
Verify against the target instruction window before accepting.
A `this` alias and a literal local used once only shape registers and stack.
Fold them back unless objdiff evidence is recorded.
When a narrow .sdata2 ordering helper is accepted for a match, keep the tactic isolated from ordinary function logic and mark it as cleanup debt.
Use the project macro for the s32-to-f32 bias instead of spelling the raw double literal.
